articles.summary: Third Quarter ACV of $45 Million, Representing 17% Growth Increases Full-Year 2026 ACV and Drug Discovery Revenue Guidance Schrödinger, Inc. (Nasdaq: SDGR) today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We are very pleased with our third quarter performance, delivering 17% ACV growth, $24 million of drug discovery revenue, and raising our full-year ACV and drug discovery revenue outlook. Our strong performance highlights the power of our industry-leading platform and also our business model in which our software and drug discovery businesses reinforce each other,” said Ramy Farid, Ph.D., chief executive officer of Schrödinger. “Applying our platform to complex drug discovery and materials science challenges gives us direct insight that continuously enhances our computational platform. articles.title: Schrödinger Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
